topPRs.title: op-acceptor: Capture logs during test run
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
**Description**

Ensure we don't lose logs if the process is killed. Previously stdout was written to a temp file outside the log directory so if tests timed out it wasn't captured in the artefacts. Now it's a temp file in the log directory and will be captured by CircleCI artefacts so the hang can be investigated.
